items.title: The preimage of a scheme theoretically dense open under a flat morphism is scheme theoretically dense
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a flat morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S and a quasi-compact open immersion V -> Y which is scheme theoretically dense in Y, the preimage f^{-1}(V) is scheme theoretically dense in X (source lines 6262-6269). The proof uses the characterization of scheme theoretically dense opens and the characterization of flatness through etale coverings to reduce the statement to the case of schemes, where the corresponding lemma applies.
